$comment: Page-template rules for the Gordon Smith Gallery theme. Human-readable version: DESIGN.md §7. Checked by scripts/lint_theme.py. The new theme (theme/, P-13) uses gs- sections only; the section types without a gs- prefix are Colorblock's, kept so the baseline (baseline/theme/) can still be linted for comparison.

page.purpose: Standard page: About, Our Story, Volunteer, FAQ, Upcoming Events, Engage, Donate, Gordon and Marion, Plan Your Visit, On Now, Upcoming Exhibitions and Past Exhibitions (their lists come from Theme settings, DS-48)

page.programme.purpose: Programme landing: Artists for Kids and its programme pages, The Smith Foundation, Public Programs, Speaker Series, Music at the Smith, Explore + Create, Art in Good Company, Volunteer. On the ArtReach videos page (Theme settings) it lists the lessons (DS-70)

metaobject/exhibition.purpose: A single exhibition, rendered from structured exhibition data (proposals/content-model.md); its works from the collection (DS-63)

metaobject/lesson.purpose: A lesson, one ArtReach video (DS-70): the lesson and its video, the works that inspired it from the collection, more lessons

page.permanent-collection.purpose: The Permanent Collection's front door (DS-62): introduction, search, ways in, featured works

page.artists.purpose: Artists A to Z (DS-62): the page's text, then every artist entry

metaobject/artist.purpose: An artist in the collection (DS-62, DS-63): header, works, documents, editions in the Shop, exhibitions

metaobject/artwork.purpose: A work in the collection (DS-62): the work and its label, then more by the artist

metaobject/collection_group.purpose: A category, theme or grouping in the collection (DS-62): header and its works

page.shop.purpose: Shop / Limited Editions landing (SHOP-01, SHOP-02): one introduction, one portfolio navigation, nothing that repeats it

collection.purpose: A portfolio or All Limited Editions

product.purpose: An artwork (limited edition). Availability and framing come from product data, not separate templates.

list-collections.purpose: Shopify's /collections page: a title and the portfolio navigation, so a visitor who lands there still reaches every portfolio; the menu and every Shop link go to the Shop landing page instead (P-06)

lockedSettings.$comment: Settings that hand design decisions to staff. They must not exist in gs- sections, and should be removed or hidden from theme sections kept in use.

codeRules.$comment: Raw values and patterns that drift, checked in gs- assets, sections and snippets (doc and comment blocks and schemas skipped). Each pattern has its message; 'files' narrows it to some of the files below; 'level' is error unless it says warning.

raw colour.message: raw colour; use a colour role from tokens.css (DESIGN.md §3.1)

raw colour function.message: raw colour function; use a colour role from tokens.css (DESIGN.md §3.1)

px font size.message: px font size; use a --gs-text-* token (DESIGN.md §4.2)

inline style colour.message: inline style colour; use a class and a colour role (DESIGN.md §3.1)

palette primitive.message: raw palette value; components use colour roles, including the fixed roles (DESIGN.md §3.1, DS-84)

transition on all.message: transition on all; name the properties that change (DESIGN.md §5.4)

unitless line height.message: unitless line height; use a --gs-leading-* token (0 and 1 are fine) (DESIGN.md §4.2)

unitless line height in font shorthand.message: unitless line height in font shorthand; use a --gs-leading-* token (DESIGN.md §4.2)

nested :has().message: a :has() inside a :has() is invalid CSS, so the browser drops the whole rule

raw ratio.message: raw ratio; pass a ratio token, such as 'var(--gs-ratio-card)' (DESIGN.md §6.4)

list without role.message: a grid or event list without role="list"; Safari doesn't announce a list without bullets as one (DESIGN.md §6.5)

brace in an output tag.message: a closing brace inside {{ }}: Shopify's Liquid ends the tag at the first one, even in a string, and refuses the file on upload (Theme Check doesn't see it); use another character

hoverOutsideMedia.$comment: A :hover rule in gs- CSS must sit inside @media (hover: hover) and (pointer: fine), so a tap never leaves a hover state stuck (DESIGN.md §5.4).
hoverOutsideMedia.message: :hover outside @media (hover: hover) and (pointer: fine); a tap on a phone would leave it stuck (DESIGN.md §5.4)

renderRules.$comment: Snippet calls that must pass certain parameters, checked in every Liquid file of the theme.

gs-media.message: pass preset: 'hero', 'card', 'tile', 'gallery' or 'full' (or an explicit sizes:), so the browser downloads the right image width
